title: Tim Taylor says the president handed him the item at dinner

tellings.quote: And he said, "I was at the dinner table with the president and handed me that."

plain: A man named Timothy Taylor says a president handed him a certain object while they sat at the dinner table together, according to Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has had many UFO encounters. Bledsoe repeats Taylor's words to Michels: "I was at the dinner table with the president and handed me that," without saying here which president or exactly what the object was.
